annotatedSteps.description: Explanation of why decomposition reactions are called the opposite of combination reactions
annotatedSteps.studentWork: In a combination reaction two or more substances combine to form a single product, whereas in a decomposition reaction a single substance breaks down into two or more simpler products. Since one joins substances and the other breaks them apart, they are opposite to each other.
annotatedSteps.teacherAnnotation: ✓ Clear and accurate explanation contrasting the two reaction types.
